Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human carbonic anhydrase II in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target name 'Carbonic anhydrase II' and assay organism 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
